nodes.statement: When does least-visited SparseLedger targeting improve mixed-discrete feasible-state discovery beyond an equal-frequency uniform targeting control?
Landscape-generalized paired algorithm effect on normalized feasible-state coverage AUC.
nodes.population: Synthetic H14 landscapes generated from the frozen Q, layout and L factorial
nodes.treatment_or_exposure: B5S least-visited targeting versus B5R uniform targeting and B1 no-injection baseline
nodes.outcome: Feasible discrete-state coverage AUC over 0 to 10000 NFE
nodes.summary_measure: Mean paired-seed difference per landscape followed by landscape-level location and 95% cluster-bootstrap CI
nodes.randomization_unit: paired algorithm seed nested within landscape
nodes.unit_mismatch_rationale: Algorithms share each seed within a landscape; seed-level pairs are averaged before inference so repeated stochastic runs are not counted as independent landscapes.

nodes.statement: At Q=4096 dispersed, B5S exceeds B5R by at least 0.01 FSCAUC without breaching the HV guardrail.
At Q=4096 dispersed, B5S exceeds B1 by at least 0.01 FSCAUC without breaching the HV guardrail.
The B5S-minus-B5R FSCAUC gain at Q=4096 exceeds that at Q=16 by at least 0.01.
Normalized feasible discrete-state coverage AUC from all evaluated candidates.
nodes.measurement_instrument: Post-evaluation H14 oracle observer at 100-NFE checkpoints
nodes.operational_definition: Trapezoidal integral of cumulative unique feasible-state count divided by K and 10000 NFE, including origin (0,0)
nodes.missingness_policy: No silent exclusion; invalid or unrecoverable run causes the affected contrast to be incomplete and inconclusive.

nodes.statement: Three landscape-level primary contrasts with paired seeds and cluster bootstrap.
nodes.method: Average paired-seed differences and L={1,4} within each landscape; use the arithmetic mean across 16 landscapes, 20000 fixed-seed landscape bootstrap replicates for a two-sided 95% percentile CI, and an exact one-sided 2^16 sign-flip test of effect minus 0.01
nodes.assumptions: Landscape seeds instantiate independent draws from the frozen generator; algorithm seeds are exchangeable stochastic repeats within landscape; run failures are not outcome-dependent exclusions
nodes.multiplicity: Holm FWER 0.05 over H14-M1, H14-M2 and H14-M3; H4 is a secondary harm boundary outside this family
nodes.independence_assumption: Only landscape instances are independent analysis units; the 10 algorithm seeds inside a landscape are paired repeats and never inflate n.

nodes.statement: The mechanism claim is falsified or remains unsupported when coverage, multiplicity or quality conditions fail.
nodes.observation: Landscape-level FSCAUC CI, Holm q and terminal normalized feasible-HV CI
nodes.threshold: support requires FSCAUC or interaction CI lower >0.01, Holm q<0.05, and relevant HV CI lower >=-0.005; otherwise fail or report inconclusive

nodes.statement: Choose the publication claim from the frozen success, failure and inconclusive branches.
nodes.if_supported: Proceed to a bounded mechanism claim for the controlled high-Q dispersed benchmark family and retain engineering-validation exclusion.
nodes.if_falsified: Do not claim SparseLedger-specific benefit; report boundary/failure and replan only in a newly authorized version.

risk_register.mitigation: Algorithm API receives benchmark evaluator and variableSpec only; oracle use is confined to post-evaluation metrics and audited.
risk_register.trigger: truthUsedByAlgorithm=true or oracle passed into generation/selection

risk_register.mitigation: Use landscape-level inference and pre-specified inconclusive branch rather than counting seeds as independent samples.
risk_register.trigger: analysis table contains n=160 independent observations per cell

risk_register.mitigation: Formal batch runner must reject execution until a separate formal authorization and source freeze exist.

baseline_fairness.data: All algorithms use the identical generated landscape and evaluator for each paired run.
baseline_fairness.compute: N=100, archive=100 and exactly 10000 evaluator calls for every algorithm.
baseline_fairness.tuning: No H14 performance tuning; canonical frozen DE and novelty parameters are reused.
baseline_fairness.evaluation_protocol: Identical checkpoints, oracle observer, metric definitions, failure rules and landscape-level analysis.
